evidence.t: Unnamed wetland, 1.1 ha, 420 m from the road.

flags.t: MU (Management Unit) 4-5, Region 4 Kootenay.

CWD (Chronic Wasting Disease) Management Zone, MU 4-5: every deer, elk and moose taken here must have its head sampled at a CWD freezer before you leave the zone (www.gov.bc.ca/CWDdropoff). Brain and spinal column (vertebrae, not the tail) may not leave the zone: leave them at the kill site or a landfill in it (synopsis pages 15, 36, 37, 99%).

Region 4: it is unlawful to feed or bait deer, elk, moose and other hoofed game, or turkeys, anywhere in the Kootenay Region (synopsis page 37, 99%). Snowmobiles may not be used for hunting in Region 4 from 1 April to 30 November (page 37, 99%).

plan: Drive: from Cranbrook, about 41 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 3 and 95 (Van Horne St S), Hwy 3 and 95, Lumberton Rd, Moyie River FSR.

F-duck-walk-0088.recDirections: From the South end of Cranbrook, proceed 10.7 km south on Hwy 3/95 to Lumberton Forest Service Road. Turn right (West). Follow this main road as it switchbacks under the powerline. At the 9 km road marker, take the left fork onto the Moyie River FSR and continue. Stay right as you pass the Semlin Creek FSR at approximately the 12km. The snowmobile trailhead and parking area is located at 14.3 km. Park here and begin snowmobiling to access the trail system. Note: This is an active haul road. Recommend having a 2-way radio and to drive with lights on.
